headline: Dawn keeps its voice down.
body: The first bus idles two streets over, a low animal sound. Windows hold a colour that is not yet day. We leave the lamp on; it has earned the hour.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: slate lifting to milk, no sun yet

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: kitchen bulb still winning against the glass

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: 06:16 BST, bin lids closed, one fox gone
